name: Shair Ali
headline: I design, build and run production web platforms, end to end.
intro: Solo full-stack developer for startups and growing businesses in the USA and Europe. From the first wireframe to the Nginx config, I take products to production and keep them running.
whatsappMessage: Hi Shair, I found your portfolio and would like to discuss a project.
portraitAlt: Portrait of Shair Ali, full-stack developer
bio: I'm Shair Ali, a full-stack developer who owns products end to end. I plan the architecture, design the interface, write the frontend and the API, model the data, wire up payments and third-party services, and then deploy and operate everything on Linux servers with automated CI/CD.

Over the last year I've shipped more than 1,800 commits across four live platforms: a real-time, pay-per-minute consultation marketplace in Italy, a lien-compliance SaaS in California, a national tenant-certification platform in the US and a hotel's website and AI guest support in Sicily.
Clients work with me because they get one accountable engineer who speaks product as well as code. I communicate clearly, ship in small, visible increments and stay around after launch.
